$meta.timebase: Every t is a FINAL-spine second, before the card pauses and clip inserts; mix_music.py and the comp route them through sh(). source_in is the file position ON the chapter's first word; the mixer pre-rolls fade_in_sec before it inside the card pause.
$meta.method_note: Energy calls come from the machine analysis blocks in video-creation/assets/music/library.json (env = 2 s per char, 0-9 absolute; segments; aggression). Every file used has an analysis block, so analyze-music.py was not run and no audio was re-scanned for energy. Loudness for the level seats was measured with ffmpeg ebur128 on the VO spans and on each placed file region (music.md: measure, never guess). Placements were checked with the mixer's own arithmetic (sh(), card fade 0.4 s, pre-roll) for the snapped card times in COVER-PLAN.json, including both possible CH4 card positions.
